lines:
flowchart TD
    EditRule[Edit project rule] --> SaveTemplate[Save rule as template]
    SaveTemplate --> SettingsStore[Persist template in app settings]
    SettingsStore --> ProjectSwitch[Switch project]
    ProjectSwitch --> SelectTemplate[Select saved template]
    SelectTemplate --> CreateRule[Create new project rule from template]
    CreateRule --> StoreRule[Persist copied rule in project DB]
    SettingsStore --> DeleteTemplate[Delete template]
    DeleteTemplate --> SettingsStore
